versions.content: When the function Spi_SyncTransmit is called while a se- quence is on transmission and SPI_SUPPORT_CONCURRENT_SYNC_TRANSMIT is disabled or another sequence is on transmission on same bus, the SPI Han- dler/Driver shall not take into account this new transmission request and the function shall return the value E_NOT_OK (see [SWS_Spi_00114]). In this case, the SPI Han- dler/Driver shall report the SPI_E_SEQ_IN_PROCESS error according to [SWS_BSW_00042] and [SWS_BSW_00045].
